description: Patches: drafts a title/metaDescription/canonical/redirect fix for one page's finding. FREE for canonical/redirect (deterministic — canonical is always the page's own URL, redirect always needs an explicit value); title/metaDescription cost one AI-gateway operation UNLESS `value` is given, which sets an explicit replacement instead of drafting one. This is a MUTATION — it creates or overwrites this page+field's draft, but does not publish it (use publish_patch for that). Requires an org admin.

issueType.description: Which finding this patch addresses — determines the field (title/metaDescription/canonical/redirect).

pageUrl.description: The exact crawled page URL this finding is on.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

value.description: An explicit replacement value instead of AI-drafting one. Required for redirect (broken_page) — there is no computable default. Never used for canonical, which is always the page's own URL.

name: draft_patch
